book.name: 2 TISALANIKA
book.title: Pol Diki Vitiya Maaj TISALANIKA Tipa Kidiy Kristen Duw Takwak

content: Wun Polawa Silasawa Timotiy, nyan ki lapa nyig sukwubana gwur adiy Godak wukijibir tikwanadiy Tisalanika tipa kidiyik. Adiy Asaay Godawa Yitaypika Duw Jisas Krais birkidiy tinadiyik.
Nyan Asaay Godawa Yitaypika Duw Jisas Kraisak bas sibanabir gwurak biraki sukwasukw tikwana mawul gwurak kwiykuw, sisuwbirik kwusida-takaan tikwana mawul kwurgwurkik.
Pol Godak wayapiy sidid adiy Tisalanika tipa kidiy Kristen duw takwak.

Nyan lakwubana aal viyakit aw li nyan Godak wayapiy sikibana gwurak tikuw, alik nyan kip nyanyi Godak wayapiy sijibir tikibanaad gwurak, aw gwuradiy Godak wukijibir tigwuradiy mawul ap yikwadanalik tikuw, awarab adiy awarwa awarwa yikwagwuradiy mawul ap yikwadana pik.

Aw gwur atawa kwurgwuralik tikuw, nyan a javik sakwar sakwar titaay, nuwukadiy tipaam vagaruw-kwanadiy God dikidiy duw takwak yarik yikwabanadiy gwurak. Aw nyan wakwabanadiy aw adiy gwurak duw taakw kwurkwadanadiy kupwaraap sapwurapa jaav nyidim tikwagwuraal ab, gwur kip Godak apawa wukijibir tikwanadiygwurik, waan.

Gwur atawa kip apawa Godak wukijibir tigwuralik tikuw, adiy duw taakw kwurkwadanadiy gwurak kupwaraap sapwurapa jaav nyidim, alik duw taakw lakwukidiy God gwuradi gikim tikwanaad. Aw God diki sukw mwiyir tidilik tikuw, alik di mwiyir tasakwu-kidadiygwur dikiwa nyanyi kwaya-gwurkik dikidi van tidadi Tipaam.
God jawjaay kwurkidadiy adiy Kristen duw takwaam jawjaay kwurdiy duw takwaam.
Aw God ata jawjaay kwurkidadiy adiy gwuraam jawjaay kwurtaay gwuradiy sipaam kagil kwiynadiy duw takwaam. Aw di dayaam atawa kwurkida, aal di mwiyir rivinaad.

Aal nyaam gwurawa nyanak God kwiykidadiyan yaap kwabakikik kidiy nyanadiy sipaar yakwanadiy kupwaraap sapwurapa javik. Aw di atawa kwurkinaad nyanadi Yitaypika Duw Jisas Krais adawur tipab tikuw, adiy di dikidiy ap samasam tikwanadiy God diki maaj kardadiy duwawa nakamwiyib dadik kidi kupwaar.
Di yanjibir tikwana yiyawa dakinaad vaat kwiyik adiy Godaam laakw maarkwanadiyim. Adiy God diki Yitaypika Duw Jisasak bwulakina Viyakita Majik wukiwukib ti maarkwanadiyim miyawa.
Dayak kwiykida vaat kitawanaal: God sitipitaay-kidadiy Yitaypika Duw diki mwutamak aw dikibir apawa gilabadiyik. Alik tikuw, dayaam kupwaraap tiyakina nyanyi.

Aal Yitaypika Duw Jisas Krais sibinin dakida Nyaam adiy miyawa dikidiy duw taakw dikidi saam kirasi-taay, yakisuw takakidanaad. Adiy miyawa dikik wukijibir tikinadiy duw taakw. Gwurabab adiy duw takwawa nakamwiyib tikinadiygwurik aw gwur ki gwurak kalivabana majik wukijibir tigwuralik tikuw.
Pol Godak nyanyi bas sidid dayak.

Alik tikuw, nyan nyanyi nyanadi Godak bas sikwabanaad gwuraam sugwiyaan kwurdik, gwur rivikigwura diki mawulaam kwagwurkikik wukikwala pik. Awarab nyan bas sikwabanaad di diki apaam gwuraam sugwiyaan kwurdikik adiy viyakita javida mwugiygwurkik gwur gwuradiy mawul kwurik wagwura pik. Aw di diki apaam ab gwuradiy Jisas Krais diki danik kwurgwuradiy yawiy mwiya mwiyab kwurkigwuradiy.

Aw di atawa kwurdik, gwur ata nyanadi Yitaypika Duw Jisas Krais dikidi saam kirasi-kigwuraad. Aw dibab ata gwuradiy saam kirasi-kidadiy aw gwur di dikidiy tigwuralik tikuw. Nyan bas sibanabir Asaay Godawa nyanadi Yitaypika Duw Jisas Kraisak biraki sukwasukw tikwana mawulaar mwugiybirik, mwiya mwiyab tilikikik.
